title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Two-map monumental Spaces + fixed frontal camera
preserve: mobile controls cannot trigger text-selection/copy UI
Map 1 supports meet arch springline and wall mass sits behind

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v17 makes true Euclidean 3D distance from each sampled world point to the camera center the sole light-distance rule. Optical-axis weighting was removed, pillar vertical sampling is denser near the base, close bases stay bright, and high/far tower tips fade almost completely into black.

open_feedback: Review close pillars: walking toward a pillar should brighten its nearby base instead of leaving it dark.
Review tower vertical fade: upper sections should be dramatically darker than bases and the highest tips should be nearly invisible.
Review floors and both maps: light should feel centered on the camera with no competing beam/cone rule.
Preserve v15 structural wall/arch fixes and v14 touch controls.
